iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

WS_REQUEST
       This event is raised when Websockets headers are present in the client request.

DESCRIPTION
       This event is raised when the following headers are present in the client request - Upgrade: websocket, Connection:
       Upgrade, Sec-Websocket-Key.

Examples
	when WS_REQUEST {
	    WS::enabled false
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.1.0
	   --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
